test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word 'Facilitated' from the given sentence.**

The author's recent bout of writer's block had hindered her typically prolific output of novels.
solution: The correct answer is: **Hindered** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Facilitated **means to make something easier or smoother. (किसी चीज़ को आसान या सहज बनाना) • **Example**: *The new software greatly facilitated the process of data analysis, making it quicker and more efficient.* • Marked option **Hindered **means to make it more difficult or obstructed. (इसे और अधिक कठिन या बाधित बनाना) • **Example**: *The heavy traffic hindered our progress, causing delays in reaching the destination.* • In the given sentence, the author's writer's block made it difficult for her to produce her usual amount of novels. • Therefore, 'Hindered' is the opposite of 'Facilitated' in this context. Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Bout **means a short period of intense activity or illness. (गहन गतिविधि या बीमारी की एक छोटी अवधि) • **Prolific **means producing many works, or being highly productive. (कई कार्य करना, या अत्यधिक उत्पादक होना) • **Output **means the amount of something produced or the result of a process. (उत्पादित किसी चीज़ की मात्रा या किसी प्रक्रिया का परिणाम) 3a:T6d7, The correct answer is: "**fighting on behalf at his country**".
